phase_title: Workflow Router Screen Correction and Guided Current Action UI
title: Figma Workflow Router UI Shell Integration
purpose: Integrate the Figma-inspired workflow-router UI shell into the real Electron/React application so the durable current required action model from WC02 becomes visible and usable.
included_scope: Integrate the Figma-inspired workflow-router shell into the existing Electron/React renderer
Use the WC02 current required action model as live state input
Add top status strip, horizontal process rail, current required action area, artifact workspace, context inspector, subordinate navigation, and bottom activity/evidence log area
Replace Figma demo/static state with live durable-state routing
Preserve existing screens as subordinate/manual fallback navigation
Confirm or update AGENTS.md with corrected Implementer feature-branch review rule if missing
Create the required WC03 Implementer Report
out_of_scope: Do not implement WC04-WC15 route-specific work
Do not create WC04 or later Work Cards
Do not create Operator validation records
Do not merge the feature branch into dev
Do not add provider SDKs, cloud services, browser automation, auth, database, or LLM API calls
Do not commit large local design archives or zip files

corrected_agent_review_rule.merge_rule: Only Architect/Operator-approved work may be merged into dev. Implementers must not merge their own feature branch into dev unless explicitly authorized.

acceptance_criteria: The app has a workflow-router shell layout rather than only a screen picker
The shell displays live WC02 current required action data
The locked workflow appears left-to-right in the process rail
The current required action area displays action title, reason, role, status, expected output, routes, fallback, and warnings
Existing screens remain reachable through subordinate/manual navigation
Figma demo/static state is removed or replaced by live app state
Renderer filesystem access is not broadened
Stale validation-target warnings do not crash the shell
Superseded Phase 03 artifacts remain warnings/context only
AGENTS.md contains the corrected Implementer feature-branch review rule, or the report confirms it was already present
Work is committed and pushed only to the WC03 feature branch
validation_expectations: Run the appropriate normal Windows validation lane
Run tests relevant to renderer/state wiring if available
Run or update fixture/static validation for current-action shell labels/state wiring if feasible
Run local path/secrets/large-file safety scan before staging
next_action_after_completion: Architect review of WC03 Implementer Report
